name: Pokemon
overview: Scripture calls believers to guard their hearts diligently, recognizing that the core of life flows from within (Proverbs 4:23). In the context of raising children and guiding their interests, the Bible instructs us to train them in the way they should go, ensuring their spiritual formation is rooted in God’s truth (Proverbs 22:6). While not labeling practices as inherently unclean, Scripture warns against returning to worldly rudiments that enslave rather than liberate (Galatians 4:3, 4:9), encouraging discernment in all activities, including those like Pokemon, to avoid bondage to elements contrary to a Christ-centered walk.
